siteSettings.aboutIntro: Elegant Interiors & Construction is an esteemed interior architect office and construction company headquartered in Garden Town, Lahore. We harmonize visionary architecture with turnkey engineering, crafting residences, corporate headquarters, and bespoke spaces that withstand the test of time.
siteSettings.aboutVision: To pioneer timeless architectural environments and luxury living spaces that elevate human experience through precision engineering, bespoke craftsmanship, and sustainable aesthetics.
siteSettings.aboutMission: Delivering turnkey architectural and construction excellence across Pakistan, translating client dreams into physical masterpieces with complete transparency and zero compromises.
siteSettings.aboutPhilosophy: Every line drawn and every brick laid is guided by the philosophy that authentic luxury is the seamless fusion of proportion, functional elegance, and enduring structural integrity.
siteSettings.constructionExpertise: With an established presence in Lahore's most prestigious enclaves—including DHA, Gulberg, and Garden Town—our turnkey construction team oversees grey structure, MEP engineering, high-end finishing, and custom woodwork with millimeter precision.
siteSettings.projectManagement: Our rigorous project governance provides clients with milestones, bill-of-quantities (BOQ) discipline, weekly on-site QA reports, and meticulous timeline adherence.
siteSettings.qualityCommitment: We select only certified structural steel, grade-A porcelain, seasoned solid hardwoods, and premium architectural hardware, backed by our comprehensive warranty.

services.title: Architectural Design
services.tagline: Innovative, bespoke blueprints and spatial layouts
services.description: Comprehensive 2D & 3D architectural master planning, structural drafting, exterior elevations, and permit-ready municipal drawings tailored to contemporary aesthetics and local climate requirements.

services.title: Construction
services.tagline: High-grade structural construction from foundation to roof
services.description: End-to-end civil construction services adhering to strict seismic and load-bearing standards. We manage excavation, RCC framing, brick masonry, slab casting, and premium waterproofing.

services.title: Interior Design
services.tagline: Timeless luxury interior architecture and curated palettes
services.description: Tailored interior solutions balancing functionality and understated opulence. From false ceilings and custom lighting design to imported Italian stone, bespoke wall textures, and luxury furnishings.

services.title: Turnkey Projects
services.tagline: Single-point responsibility from bare ground to handover
services.description: Complete hassle-free project execution where we oversee everything: architectural blueprints, material procurement, grey construction, interior finishing, and smart home automation until key handover.

services.title: Customise
services.tagline: Made-to-order architectural elements and custom woodwork
services.description: Bespoke architectural woodwork, custom wardrobes, signature vanity units, CNC metal screens, imported marble waterjet inlays, and customized artisanal furniture pieces crafted for unique spaces.

services.title: Construction Projects
services.tagline: Large-scale commercial, institutional, and residential builds
services.description: Execution of multistory residential complexes, commercial plazas, corporate offices, and retail showrooms with rigorous BOQ control, daily safety compliance, and certified site supervisors.

services.title: Exterior Design
services.tagline: Striking facade treatments, boundary walls, and illumination
services.description: Distinctive facade architecture combining porcelain tiles, louvers, HPL sheets, fair-faced concrete, and dynamic architectural accent illumination that commands immediate curb appeal.

services.title: House Decor
services.tagline: Refined accessories, soft furnishings, and art curation
services.description: Curating the emotional atmosphere of your home through bespoke textiles, imported wallpaper accents, curated artwork, acoustic panels, bespoke rugs, and handcrafted decorative elements.

services.title: Interior Decor
services.tagline: Elevated stylistic styling for residential and corporate spaces
services.description: Detailed interior styling that elevates every corner. We optimize color harmony, tactile textures, indoor landscaping, ambient scenting, and bespoke accent furniture to define personal identity.

services.title: Project Management Services
services.tagline: Transparent supervision, schedule tracking, and vendor control
services.description: Independent or integrated owner's representation. We oversee contractors, audit material invoices, monitor critical path schedules, conduct rigorous quality checks, and eliminate costly delays.

services.title: Residence Architecture
services.tagline: Custom luxury villas, contemporary bungalows, and estates
services.description: Specialized architectural practice for 10 Marla, 1 Kanal, 2 Kanal, and luxury farmhouse residences across Lahore. We maximize natural daylight, airflow, privacy, and family lifestyle requirements.

services.title: Residential Properties
services.tagline: Property development, turnkey remodeling, and luxury expansions
services.description: Upgrading existing residential properties into modern luxury showpieces. Complete structural extensions, addition of master suites, rooftop garden terraces, and modern floor plan conversions.

services.title: Value Engineering
services.tagline: Optimizing architectural costs without compromising luxury or strength
services.description: In-depth technical analysis of architectural specifications to recommend cost-effective structural solutions, alternate high-performance materials, and energy-efficient building envelopes.

projects.title: The Al-Miraj Contemporary Villa
projects.description: A masterclass in modern tropical brutalism and warm minimalism. Features a double-height travertine marble foyer, custom walnut joinery, smart automated climate control, and an internal courtyard with cascading water fountain.

projects.title: The Obsidian Executive Headquarters
projects.description: Corporate workspace designed for high-performance productivity and sophisticated brand presence. Incorporates acoustic slatted timber paneling, concealed magnetic track lighting, ergonomic executive suites, and private boardrooms.

projects.title: Garden Town Modernist Bungalow
projects.description: Strategically located near Central Plaza, this estate harmonizes raw architectural concrete with brushed brass screening and lush biophilic perimeter gardens. Completed on time with value engineering.

projects.title: Cantt Luxury Penthouse Remodel
projects.description: A luxurious sky residence featuring customized book-matched Statuario marble flooring, bespoke velvet banquettes, fluted oak partitions, and a panoramic rooftop dining pergola.

projects.title: Barkat Commercial Plaza Facade
projects.description: Revitalization of a high-traffic commercial building in Barkat Market. Features energy-efficient low-E curtain wall glazing, dark charcoal composite aluminum cladding, and integrated illuminated signage.

projects.title: Model Town Heritage Residence
projects.description: Sympathetic contemporary expansion of a traditional Model Town family residence. Preserved historical sightlines while integrating modern open-concept living, solar thermal insulation, and a gourmet chef kitchen.
